TOP LEFT: Zechariah 4. A detailed golden lampstand with a bowl and exactly seven lit oil lamps, standing between exactly two mature olive trees, one on each side. Olive trunks with textured bark, silver-green leaves; subtle evening light. A study interpretation of the vision, not a verified ancient reconstruction.
TOP RIGHT: Zechariah 5. A large unrolled parchment scroll flying dramatically above ancient stone rooftops and rolling hills, suspended naturally in the wind, dark blue sky and warm dawn light. Its writing is only subtle non-legible marks, not readable script.
BOTTOM LEFT: Zechariah 6. EXACTLY FOUR clearly separate two-wheeled ancient horse-drawn chariots emerging between two bronze-toned mountains. Distinct teams in red/chestnut, black, white and dappled gray horses. Strong perspective and legible silhouettes, no modern wagons or wheels.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Jeremiah 24. Close-up still life of EXACTLY TWO woven baskets placed before an ancient temple stone threshold; left basket filled with ripe, beautiful split purple figs, right basket with visibly shriveled, rotten spoiled figs. These are figs, not apples or grapes. Dramatic soft side light makes the good/bad contrast immediately legible.
Keep all essential subjects comfortably within their quadrant. Do not blend the four stories. High visual craft, restrained palette, expressive real textures.
